## Activity

During November 2019, River Outreach recorded 46 captures. This report summarises the activity recorded for the month and provides the associated image-quality and grading results. The capture total is the basis for reviewing the proportion of images available for assessment and the number that produced a referable result.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 5 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 10.9 per cent. These images were not available for grading, and the result is reported separately from the grading outcome. The figures provide a concise measure of the proportion of monthly captures that could not proceed through assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 0 days. This indicates that, for the reporting period, the midpoint of the recorded grading lag was 0 days. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide the monthly operational summary for River Outreach for November 2019.
